verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as periodic experiment runs, is a fair question for an AI evaluation and observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no scheduling capability. Alerts with a time window are an adjacent monitoring control, not user-defined recurring jobs, and experiments are documented only as one-off runs started from the UI or via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
